targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  category,
  subcategory,
  source,
  source_id,
  region,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS lat
FROM pois
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND CASE
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring}
    ELSE false
  END
  AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  id,
  source,
  source_id,
  category,
  subcategory,
  name,
  region,
  unit_name,
  reserve_url,
  phone,
  info_url,
  fetched_at,
  updated_at,
  provider_ref,
  properties AS raw_properties,
  ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::jsonb AS geometry
FROM pois
WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring};

SELECT
  r.id AS reservable_id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS rid,
  r.type,
  r.vendor,
  r.vendor_id,
  r.name,
  r.loop,
  r.site_type,
  r.source,
  r.updated_at,
  r.deleted_at,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
  count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS snapshots_last_7d,
  bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS any_available_last_7d
FROM reservable_pois rp
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring}
  AND (
    ${include_deleted_reservables:sqlstring} = 'true'
    OR r.deleted_at IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY r.id
ORDER BY r.type ASC, r.loop NULLS LAST, r.name NULLS LAST, rid ASC;

WITH linked AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM reservable_pois rp
  JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
  WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring}
    AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    reservable_id,
    max(observed_at) AS latest_observed_at
  FROM availability_snapshot
  WHERE reservable_id IN (SELECT id FROM linked)
  GROUP BY reservable_id
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS linked_reservables,
  count(latest.reservable_id) AS reservables_with_observations,
  max(latest.latest_observed_at) AS newest_observation,
  now() - max(latest.latest_observed_at) AS newest_observation_age
FROM linked
LEFT JOIN latest ON latest.reservable_id = linked.id;

SELECT
  provider_ref,
  properties
FROM pois
WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring};

list.name: poi_category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __text, category AS __value FROM pois WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY category ASC

list.name: poi_id
list.query: WITH matches AS (SELECT id::text || ' - ' || name || ' [' || category || ']' AS __text, id::text AS __value, name, id FROM pois WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring})) ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC LIMIT 500) SELECT __text, __value FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT 'No matching POI' AS __text, '__none' AS __value WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches)
